allow: PowerShell($chrome = @\("$env:ProgramFiles\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe", "${env:ProgramFiles\(x86\)}\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe"\) | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if \($chrome\) { & $chrome --headless --disable-gpu --window-size=800,400 --screenshot="$env:TEMP\\rdash_menu.png" --virtual-time-budget=4000 http://localhost:8765/index.html; Test-Path "$env:TEMP\\rdash_menu.png" } else { "no chrome" })

PowerShell($edge = "${env:ProgramFiles\(x86\)}\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge.exe"; if \(-not \(Test-Path $edge\)\) { $edge = "$env:ProgramFiles\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge.exe" }; if \(Test-Path $edge\) { & $edge --headless=new --disable-gpu --window-size=800,400 --screenshot="$env:TEMP\\rdash_menu.png" --virtual-time-budget=5000 http://localhost:8765/index.html | Out-Null; Start-Sleep 1; Test-Path "$env:TEMP\\rdash_menu.png" } else { "no edge" })
